description: This Java class implements a dialog fragment for editing the title of a note within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages user input, branding, and interaction callbacks to notify when the title has been changed.
external_files: R (resource identifiers - R.layout.dialog_edit_title, R.string.change_note_title, R.string.action_edit_save, R.string.simple_cancel)

classes.name: EditTitleDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that allows users to edit the title of a note, with branding and callback support.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the listener and retrieves the old title from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog interface for editing the title.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Shows the keyboard for the title input field when activity is created.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the dialog fragment with the initial title parameter.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog UI components.
